submission.justification: Absorber-F1 at 5 mm is the best-performing simulated configuration recorded. It gives a 100 GeV electron energy resolution of 3.144%, comfortably better than the 4.5% hard requirement and better than the best sampled Absorber-F3 result of 3.901%; Absorber-F2 is rejected because all sampled resolutions exceed 4.5%. The selected plate thickness is within the allowed 2–10 mm range. However, no residual-dose information was found or verified for any candidate, so the 20 uSv/h hands-on-maintenance dose requirement remains unverified and must be checked before the design can be fully qualified.

requirements.requirement: Absorber must be one of the three materials listed in candidate_specs.md.
requirements.evidence: There are three candidates, and the selected option is Absorber-F1, one of the listed candidates; final_allowed_material_pass = 1.

requirements.requirement: Achieve the best possible energy resolution at 100 GeV.
requirements.evidence: Fine scan global best is Absorber-F1 at 5 mm with resolution 3.144%, better than Absorber-F3 best 3.901% and Absorber-F2 best 5.282%.

requirements.requirement: Energy resolution for 100 GeV electrons must be 4.5% or better.
requirements.evidence: Selected Absorber-F1 at 5 mm has final_recommended_resolution_pct = 3.144, which is below the 4.5% cut; final_resolution_pass = 1.

requirements.requirement: Residual dose rate at 1 m after one week cooldown must not exceed 20 uSv/h.
requirements.evidence: dose_info_found = 0; dose_status_unknown_Absorber_F1 = 1; final_residual_dose_verified = 0. No recorded result verifies compliance with the 20 uSv/h limit.

requirements.requirement: Plate thickness must be between 2 and 10 mm.
requirements.evidence: Selected plate thickness is 5 mm, within the allowed range; final_plate_range_pass = 1.

requirements.requirement: Finish by submitting one recommended material and plate thickness.
requirements.evidence: Submitted recommendation: Absorber-F1 with 5 mm plates.
